documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Ken Enterprises Limited reported profitable growth in FY24-25, achieving a 20.75% increase in revenues to H49,403.79 Lakh and a 30.32% growth in EBITDA to H3,476.04 Lakh amidst a prolonged industry downtrend. The company successfully completed an IPO, raising H53.0273 Crore to replace high-cost working capital loans, reduce debt, and strengthen its net worth to H111.60 Lakh. Management highlighted an asset-light manufacturing approach, strategic product outsourcing, and raw material sourcing directly from mills to moderate costs and enhance capital efficiency. For the future, the company outlined a vision to reach H1,000 Crore in revenue by 2028-2029 while expanding into fabric processing capabilities.

guidance.claim: The company projects an EBITDA margin of 10.30% by 2028-2029.

demand_outlook.claim: The global textile sector sustained its downtrend during the last financial year, with most industry observers considering it the longest in living memory.
demand_outlook.quote: The global textile sector sustained its downtrend during the last financial year. Most industry observers felt that this was the longest downtrend in living memory.

demand_outlook.claim: The industry was characterized by losses or wafer-thin margins across the value chain from yarn to fabric to apparel manufacture cum marketing.
demand_outlook.quote: The industry was marked by losses or wafer-thin margins across the value chain - from yarn to fabric to apparel manufacture cum marketing.

demand_outlook.claim: The global and domestic textile sectors passed through a challenging period marked by demand compression, price volatility, and a cautious retail environment.
demand_outlook.quote: The global and domestic textile sectors have been passing through a challenging period, marked by demand compression, price volatility, and a cautious retail environment.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
